description: Fetch Medium Staff Picks, the official editorial curation list maintained by Medium Staff. Loads more entries by scrolling, up to 100 items. Returns staff-curated articles with metadata and curator notes. No API key required.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of items to return (1-100). The list lazy-loads on scroll; the command scrolls until the limit is reached or the list is exhausted (then returns fewer items with partial=true).
